description: This Java source file defines the implementation of an asynchronous command client for the Eclipse Hono project, including methods for sending commands, creating client instances, and managing message addresses.

classes.name: AsyncCommandClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of an asynchronous command client for sending commands with responses in the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the outcome, returning a Future of ProtonDelivery.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Starts a tracing span for sending an asynchronous command, using the parent span context.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns null; method possibly overridden from superclass.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint string for command requests.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address for a device command based on tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: getLinkTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the link target address for the sender based on tenant ID.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and returns a Future of ProtonDelivery.

methods.name: sendAsyncCommand
methods.description: Constructs and sends an asynchronous command message with optional content type and properties.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new AsyncCommandClient instance for a given connection, tenant, and close hook.
